parameters.jsCode: const row=$input.first()?.json||{}; function parse(v,f){if(v==null)return f;if(typeof v==='string'){try{return JSON.parse(v)}catch{return f}}return v} const ga=parse(row.generated_asset,null); if(!ga)return[{json:{ok:false,registered:false,error:'Asset not found or could not be registered'}}]; return[{json:{ok:true,registered:true,generatedAsset:ga,job:parse(row.job,null)}}];
